name: scrawling_crawler_each_player_draws_opponents_pay
notes: M6 mapper. Printed: 'At the beginning of your upkeep, each player draws a card. Whenever an opponent draws a card, that player loses 1 life.' The Crawler enters on seat 0's turn 1 (from hand). Turn 2: seat 1 draws in its draw step and loses 1. Turn 3, seat 0's upkeep: each player draws a card; seat 1, an opponent, loses 1 more; seat 0 draws again in its draw step and loses nothing. Seat 0: 2 cards, 20 life; seat 1: 2 cards, 18 life. (Its record waited on the G1 probe's GameOver at setup, fixed 2026-11-17.)
